text: Local testing without a headset: desktop stereo viewer + Monado simulated HMD
description: A side-by-side L/R + depth viewer with mouse/WASD head motion. The OpenXR loader 1.1.60 is already installed; Monado or SteamVR can provide the runtime.

status.comment: dev.sh: Monado with qwerty-steered simulated HMD + debug GUI, av-controls faders, live shader reload, Rust rebuild/restart; used all session for timing (build/dev/app.log). Caveat: Monado refuses a second concurrent session.
